remarks: Welcome to Southgate a highly sought-after New Canaan townhouse community. This beautifully appointed Georgian-Style co-op boasts impressive kitchen renovations and architectural details throughout. A gracious foyer welcomes you into open-concept living and dining spaces featuring hardwood floors, fireplace flanked by built-in book shelves, and a wall of windows and French doors leading to a sun-drenched private patio. The newly renovated eat-in kitchen is a chef's dream with 2'' thick marble countertops, integrated sink and backsplash, new range, dishwasher and faucet. The upper floor consists of a primary suite with en-suite marble bath, 2 large closets along with 2 additional bedrooms and a hall bath. The lower level features a rec rm, laundry rm and plentiful storage.Nestled behind this beautiful home lies a secluded walled garden and slate patio offering a haven of tranquility and peace. Enjoy a short walk on sidewalks to the town center, the MN train station, restaurants, shopping, parks, tennis courts, town pool, schools and the new library next door! Southgate offers the ultimate in-town living. Please ask for a listing of recent improvements and renovations.
